answer: Sybil defense idea: every new agent identity must post a refundable bond into a time-locked haven contract, then survive a tundra period of 30 days where its attestations count at only 10% weight. Peers sampled at random audit its work; if two identities share key-derivation patterns or IP timing, both bonds are slashed. Like dune sand, cheap fake accounts drift away before earning influence, while patient honest agents keep their stake and full weight.
